description: Add renewal path independent of Chat.open/widget.context initialization. Require same user/widget/page and fresh replacement JWT, atomically bind replacement, update authorization expiry/timers and ack server deadlines. Preserve subscription, active response correlation, selected conversation, streaming deltas, messages, React identity, draft, and settings. Keep prior credential valid to its original expiry; ignore stale timers and acknowledgements. Test renewal amid streaming and failure.
title: Implement in-place server authentication renewal
